content: निषादः .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of one of the wild aboriginal tribes in India, such as hunters, fishermen <ab>&c.</ab>; a mountaineer; मा निषाद प्रतिष्ठां त्वमगमः शाश्वतीः समा <ls>Rām. 1. 2. 15</ls>; <ls>R. 14. 52</ls>, <ls n="R. 14.">70</ls>; <ls>U. 2. 5</ls>. .²2 A man of a degraded tribe in general, an outcast, a Chāṇḍāla. .²3 Especially, the son of a Brāhmaṇa by a Śūdra woman; <ab>cf.</ab> ब्राह्मणाद्वैश्यकन्यायामम्बष्ठो नाम जायते . निषादः शूद्रकन्यायां यः पारशव उच्यते .. <ls>Ms. 10. 8</ls>. .²4 (In music) The first (more properly the last or seventh) note of the Hindu gamut; गीतकलाविन्यासमिव निषादानुगतम् <ls>K. 31</ls> (where it has sense 1 also). .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of a Kalpa.
